claims.claim: In TableDebouncer.workerLoop in debounce.go:185-214, when td.ctx.Done() fires, it only takes td.tasks and returns without draining batches remaining in td.flushCh, while in-flight goroutines in case batch := <-td.flushCh receive td.ctx directly without td.wg tracking.

In SnapshotRunner.Stop() in Demo P13-2 of 09_tasks_solution_pg_oom_53200.md:1821-1839, r.stopping.Store(true) is set so in-flight snapshots finish their current batch and pause at the batch boundary, only calling r.stopCancel() if r.wg.Wait() does not finish within 10 seconds.

In RequestCancel in Demo P13-7 of 09_tasks_solution_pg_oom_53200.md:2233-2264, PENDING, PAUSED, or stale RUNNING jobs (>45s without heartbeat) are immediately transitioned to status = 'CANCELLED' with finished_at = NOW() and transmute_schedule.last_status = 'cancelled'.

In TransmuteHandler.Stop() in Demo P13-5 of 09_tasks_solution_pg_oom_53200.md:2119-2155, Stop() first signals long-running TransmuterModule jobs via h.svc.SetStopping(true) and waits on h.wg.Wait(), then stops all TableDebouncers via td.Stop().

In TransmuterModule.Run in Demo P13-4 of 09_tasks_solution_pg_oom_53200.md:1978-1994, each chunk iteration checks IsCancelRequested (finishing with CANCELLED) and t.IsStopping() (finishing with PAUSED at the chunk boundary).

In TableDebouncer.drainRemainingOnStop() in Demo P13-1 of 09_tasks_solution_pg_oom_53200.md:1758-1785, all queued batches in td.flushCh and remaining events in td.tasks are flushed with context.Background() before workerLoop returns.

In MasterTransmuteJobHandler.CancelTransmute in Demo P13-7 of 09_tasks_solution_pg_oom_53200.md:2301-2323, PENDING, RUNNING, and PAUSED jobs are accepted, RequestCancel is called, cdc.cmd.transmute-cancel is published via h.natsPublisher, and the updated job status is returned.
